ours: costs: the Classic mortars recipe, 75 steel as its stuff plus 150 steel
note: Wiki-checked 2026-10-28, with RimWorld's Classic mortars rules (no reinforced barrels, which are not made in the game): 75 metal + 150 steel + 6 components, 2000 ticks of work, 180 HP and 28% flammable in steel, beauty -20, cover 40%, 2x2, miss radius 13 tiles. It holds one shell at a time and can't fire under a roof. Its blast (50 Bomb, 4.9 m) comes 4 s after it drops below a third of its HP in RimWorld; ours goes off when it is destroyed.

label: rocketswarm launcher
note: Wiki-checked 2026-10-28: 200 steel + 20 plasteel + 2 components + 180 chemfuel, 10000 ticks of work, 200 HP, 70% flammable, beauty -20, cover 40%, 2x2, 150 W. It fires only at a point the player picks. Its blast (50 Bomb, 6.9 m) comes 4 s after it is badly damaged in RimWorld; ours goes off when it is destroyed.
